text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Exhibition centre in 2.5 million dinar expansion.
- Bahrain Telecommunications Co launches GSM international service to Saudi Arabia and Italy.
- Bahrain's garment industry on the rebound.
- Bahraini-Spanish joint venture company formed to tap investments in Bahrain.
- Bahrain's cabinet discusses proposals to develop the health sector.
- Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait to pay 6.8 million dinar dividend to shareholders for 1996.
- Bahrain's share index climbs 23.03 points in active trade.
- Oil minister discusses with Arab and international firms ways of boosting coordination in refining and marketing of oil.
